guarantees.claim: app_reqs is always assigned to a bit-vector where each bit i in [0, NumAppIntf-1] equals app_i[i].valid, and all higher bits are 0.

uncertain_points.claim: Misconfiguration of NumAppIntf parameter relative to the declared bit-width of app_reqs or the number of app_i interfaces could cause out-of-range bit-select leading to X propagation or incorrect request mask.
uncertain_points.cond: if NumAppIntf exceeds declared dimensions of app_reqs or app_i array
uncertain_points.risk: app_reqs may drive a request vector used for arbitration or control; incorrect bits could lead to spurious requests or functional failures.
